extracted.intended_audience: patent practitioners and stakeholders (petitioner and patent-owner counsel, USPTO/PTAB staff, policy makers, researchers)
extracted.subtask_description: A fiscal-year statistical report of Patent Trial and Appeal Board (PTAB) trial activity and outcomes (IPR/PGR) including counts, rates, and outcome categorizations by petition, patent, claim, technology, month, and disposition type.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions filed by trial type
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts and percentages of petitions filed by trial type for FY25 (IPR and PGR). Example: IPR 1,361 (95%), PGR 72 (5%), Total 1,433.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Trial types include Inter Partes Review (IPR) and Post Grant Review (PGR).

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions filed by technology
rubrics_metrics.description: Breakdown of petitions by technology category with counts and percentages for FY25: Electrical/Computer, Mechanical/Business Methods, Chemical, Bio/Pharma, Design.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples from FY25: Electrical/Computer 967 (67%), Mechanical/Business Methods 281 (20%), Chemical 82 (6%), Bio/Pharma 102 (7%), Design 1 (<0.5%).

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions filed by month
rubrics_metrics.description: Monthly counts of petitions filed across the fiscal year (separate series for IPR and PGR).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shows month-by-month filing patterns (e.g., Oct–Sep) and separate counts for IPRs and PGRs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disposition rates by decision type
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts and percentage distribution of disposition types (e.g., DSCO, Board Referred, Granted, Denied) for concluded matters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes DSCO (Director Discretionary Considerations) as a disposition category; shows raw counts and percent of total dispositions (e.g., Granted 620 (66%) of some subset).

rubrics_metrics.name: Institution rates by petition (FY21–FY25)
rubrics_metrics.description: Percent of petitions instituted vs denied (and DSCO denials) across fiscal years reported on a per-petition basis (by petition).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shows year-by-year instituted/denied/DSCO denied proportions (example: FY25 institution rate by petition shown as a percent).

rubrics_metrics.name: Institution rates by patent (FY21–FY25)
rubrics_metrics.description: Percent of patents with institution vs denial across fiscal years reported on a per-patent basis (by patent).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides year-by-year instituted/denied percentages measured at the patent level (distinct from per-petition rates).

rubrics_metrics.name: Institution rate by technology
rubrics_metrics.description: Institution rates broken down by technology category for FY25 (e.g., Bio/Pharma, Chemical, Electrical/Computer, Mechanical/Business Methods, Design).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Institution rate for each technology is calculated by dividing petitions instituted by decisions on institution (i.e., petitions instituted plus petitions denied). The outcomes of decisions on institution responsive to requests for rehearing are excluded. Example figures: Electrical/Computer 45% (389 of 860); Chemical 65% (51 of 78); Design 0% (0 of 2).

rubrics_metrics.name: Settlement rate and settlement timing
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts and percentage rate of settlements overall and separated into pre-institution and post-institution settlements for FY21–FY25.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Settlement rate is calculated by dividing total settlements by concluded proceedings in each fiscal year (i.e., denied institution, settled, dismissed, requested adverse judgment, and final written decision), excluding joined cases. Shows both numeric counts (e.g., total settlements 465) and percent settlement rates by year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Outcomes by petition
rubrics_metrics.description: Categorization of petition-level outcomes with counts and percentages (e.g., Institution Denied, FWD All Unpatentable, DSCO Denied, Settled, FWD Mixed, FWD All Patentable, Req. Adverse Judgment, Dismissed).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FWD patentability or unpatentability is reported with respect to the claims at issue in the FWD; joined cases are excluded. Example FY25 petition outcomes: Institution Denied 342 (23%), FWD All Unpatentable 250 (17%), Settled 368 (25%).

rubrics_metrics.name: Outcomes by patent
rubrics_metrics.description: Categorization of patent-level outcomes with counts and percentages (similar categories to petition-level outcomes but aggregated per patent).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: 'Mixed Outcome' is shown for patents receiving more than one type of outcome from the list of: denied, settled, dismissed, and/or requested adverse judgment only. A patent is listed in an FWD category if it ever received a FWD, regardless of other outcomes. Examples: Institution Denied 270 (22%), FWD All Unpatentable 230 (19%), Settled 284 (23%).

rubrics_metrics.name: Outcomes by claim challenged
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts and percentages of claim-level dispositions for challenged claims (e.g., Institution Denied, DSCO Denied, FWD Unpatentable, Challenged But No FWD, FWD Patentable, Disclaimed, Dismissed).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides claim-level totals (e.g., 22,524 total challenged claims) and percentages (e.g., FWD Unpatentable 5,051 (22%)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Outcomes by claim (categories and interpretation)
rubrics_metrics.description: Breakdown of all claims (in patent vs challenged), and claim-level outcomes including 'No DI', 'No FWD', Disclaimed, Patentable, Unpatentable, etc., with counts and percentages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: 'No DI' and 'No FWD' mean the claim was challenged but not addressed in a DI/FWD, e.g., due to settlement. Example statistics: 22% of challenged claims and 47% of instituted claims were found unpatentable by a preponderance of the evidence. Shows totals like In Patent 28,665; Challenged 22,524; Not Challenged 6,141.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition: DSCO
rubrics_metrics.description: DSCO stands for 'Director Discretionary Considerations' and is used as an outcome/disposition category in PTAB reporting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: DSCO appears in disposition and outcome tables and is treated as a distinct decision type (e.g., DSCO Denied counts).

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition: 'No DI' and 'No FWD'
rubrics_metrics.description: 'No DI' and 'No FWD' indicate that a challenged claim was not addressed in a Decision on Institution (DI) or Final Written Decision (FWD).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These statuses typically occur when claims are not addressed due to settlement or other procedural reasons; they are counted separately in claim-level outcome tallies.
